newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Best bid for Sri Lanka naphtha by Vitol at -53 cts.
newsitem.headline: Best bid for Sri Lanka naphtha by Vitol at -53 cts.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has received the best bid in its naphtha sales tender for July from Dutch trader Vitol at 53 cents per barrel below Singapore spot quotes, free-on-board Colombo basis, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The tender, which offered 125,000 barrels of light naphtha for July 18-19 lifting, closed on July 2 but bids will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC sold 110,000-125,000 barrels of light naphtha to Swiss trader Glencore at $1.23 per barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes, for May 2-3 lifting, fob Colombo.
